claim: We can model a general contribution relation and specialize it into authorship, material creation and archival production.

I prefer records creator for the entity responsible for creating or accumulating the fonds in the course of its functions. Producer should be reserved for technical or audiovisual cases when the record specifies it.
We will therefore not close a single equivalence today. Mateo will collect twenty archive examples, Diego will analyze their effect on entity linking and Yara will propose bilingual definitions.
The current guide should remain marked as a draft until the distinction is resolved.
